falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified if unknown terminal provider errors had a distinct bounded fault class and recovery policy, or if every emitting path proved the error was authentication terminal before using auth semantics. Exact source proves neither. Implementation must define clear, retry, incident-breaker, and durability semantics for the new class.
impact: Unclassified provider failures can be diagnosed and cleared as authentication failures, applying the wrong recovery proof and obscuring their real cause.
